security_spec.violation_condition: In XiangShan RTL, when a write to mpmpdeleg.pmpnum triggers an indirect update of hspmpdeleg.pmpnum (due to the hardware invariant that mpmpdeleg.pmpnum + hspmpdeleg.pmpnum ≤ total_PMP_entries), the hardware must reduce hspmpdeleg.pmpnum even if the new value is ≤ the index of a locked hSPMP entry. A violation occurs if: (1) The CSR write logic unconditionally blocks hspmpdeleg.pmpnum from dropping below a locked entry's index for ALL write paths, preventing the mpmpdeleg-triggered update and leaving hspmpdeleg in an architecturally stale state that contradicts mpmpdeleg; OR (2) The CSR write logic fails to enforce the locked-entry-index guard on DIRECT writes to hspmpdeleg.pmpnum, allowing malicious HS-mode software to shrink hspmpdeleg below locked hSPMP entries by writing hspmpdeleg directly rather than through mpmpdeleg, thereby re-delegating locked entries to vSPMP and stripping hypervisor protections.
security_spec.summary: hspmpdeleg.pmpnum reduction below locked hSPMP entry indices is only legal when triggered by mpmpdeleg writes; hardware must distinguish direct vs indirect write paths or risk locked-entry bypass through CSR writes

findings.finding: The hspmpdeleg and mpmpdeleg CSRs referenced in the security spec are not implemented in the XiangShan RTL. The codebase has only a conventional PMP with 32 real entries (pmpcfg0-15, pmpaddr0-63), Smepmp support via mseccfg (MML/MMWP/RLB), and Ssnpm/Smmpm support via mseccfg.PMM. There is no sPMP, no hypervisor-PMP delegation mechanism, no pmpnum field, and no HS/VS PMP entry split. The audit condition describes a feature that has not yet been added to this branch (kunminghu-v3).
